seasonal_reference_rule: Target availability minus 24 hours, eligible and observed by issue time in the same session/partition. Baseline-only access to an older observation; predictive inputs stay at six hours.
candidate_initialization: New parameters trained from scratch; no pretrained or existing application model weights.
incomplete_prediction_policy: Report expected/finite/failed/abstained counts. Conditional metrics may be diagnostic; only complete primary-cohort predictions qualify for model ranking.
lower_do_diagnostic: Target at or below the linearly interpolated 10th percentile of the 100 distinct training DO bins, threshold frozen during model development before validation/test scoring. This is a relative lower-tail subset, not a biological safety event.
event_metrics_status: Unsupported: no independently established species/environment event definition or adequate event evidence in this pilot.
seed_reporting: Validation selects the family/settings using mean seed MAE; report each seed and mean/range, never choose the lowest-error test seed. Seed 17 is the predeclared primary artifact, not an ensemble.
test_use: One final evaluation of locked models/transforms/diagnostic calibration; no test-based tuning, seed selection, clipping or boundary changes.
